Summarise shot success by year and zone

Source: R/summary.R
shot_zone_summary.Rd

Provides aggregated shot accuracy by year and basic zone classification.

Usage

shot_zone_summary(data = nba_shots)

Arguments

data

A tibble like nba_shots.

Value

A tibble with columns: year, shot_zone_basic, and accuracy.

Examples

shot_zone_summary()
#> # A tibble: 168 × 5
#>     year shot_zone_basic       attempts  made accuracy
#>    <dbl> <fct>                    <int> <int>    <dbl>
#>  1  1997 Above the Break 3         8042  2696   0.335 
#>  2  1997 Backcourt                   76     2   0.0263
#>  3  1997 In The Paint (Non-RA)     9622  3566   0.371 
#>  4  1997 Left Corner 3              929   322   0.347 
#>  5  1997 Mid-Range                25295  9790   0.387 
#>  6  1997 Restricted Area          22531 13437   0.596 
#>  7  1997 Right Corner 3             883   342   0.387 
#>  8  1998 Above the Break 3        17652  6092   0.345 
#>  9  1998 Backcourt                  182    10   0.0549
#> 10  1998 In The Paint (Non-RA)    18391  6849   0.372 
#> # ℹ 158 more rows
